# Skilly

Skilly is a public directory of agent skills.

## Search

Use the public JSON endpoint to find skills:

GET https://skilly.sh/api/v1/skills/search

It accepts either `q` for broad full-text search or field-specific parameters:

- `name` — skill name
- `description` — YAML frontmatter description
- `category` — catalog category
- `source` — source repository
- `instructions` — full SKILL.md instructions
- `owner` — GitHub owner filter
- `limit` — maximum 200 results

Field-specific parameters can be combined. Example:

https://skilly.sh/api/v1/skills/search?name=algorithmic&category=Design

Search requires no authentication and returns JSON. Each result includes its name, description, category, source repository, install URL, and canonical URL.

## Documentation

- API reference: https://skilly.sh/docs/api
- OpenAPI: https://skilly.sh/api/openapi.json
